versions.name: Landscape Architecture
versions.description: Walk a designed site and read its plan, identify trees, shrubs, and ground covers by shape and texture, then measure, draw to scale, and redesign an entry area for drainage, comfort, and safety.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
